about: World tiers I-IV (docs/design/ARPG.md section 7.3), read by logic/Content/WorldTiers.cs. The world fact 'world.tier' picks one (default below). health/damage scale the foes of story fights (never allies, arenas or maps); itemLevels is added to drop levels; rare/legendary multiply the drop chances; kitEvery (M3) multiplies the kit's waits in story fights (champions' affixes, packs' tells: under 1, more marks); kit scales only the telegraph kit's damage (its blows are a share of her max life, so they do not take the x3/x6). opens: the world fact that unlocks the tier (null: always open).
